one_line: Buy US SP 500 / US Small Cap 2000 at 15:00 NY when the session closes at a 7-session low; exit next session (TP 0.75 ATR, SL 3 ATR).
timeframe: H1 bars, daily-session decisions (session close = 15:00 New York)

logic.entry: At close of the H1 bar opening 14:00 NY: if session close <= lowest of last 7 session closes -> market BUY at next bar open (15:00 NY). Long only.
logic.exit: Time exit at close of 22nd H1 bar after fill (next session 15:00 NY) unless SL/TP hit first.
logic.stop: 3.0 x ATR14 of session bars (hard SL on every order).
logic.sizing: Broker minimum 0.1 unit per index (optional risk-% sizing in cBot, clamped to [min, MaxVolumeUnits]).
logic.risk: Start balance $700 (min that passes all gates); planned risk/trade median $24 SP, $13 RUT; daily loss limit 8%, equity kill-switch 25%, pause after 7 consecutive losses, skip if planned risk >12% balance.

parameters.name: N
parameters.meaning: lookback in sessions for the closing low

parameters.name: hold_sessions
parameters.meaning: time exit after N sessions (22 H1 bars for 1)

parameters.name: signal_hour_ny
parameters.meaning: NY open hour of the session-closing H1 bar
